'''Night's Shade''' is a not very known [[weave]] that is activated by the [[Bloodknife ring]], a ''[[ter'angreal]]''. It provides the ring wearer with more strength and speed and allows them to better blend in with the shadows. However, the granted attributes come at the cost of the user's life. In fact, the weave rapidly consumes the vital resources of the person activating it so their life is shortened to only few weeks after the first use. The weave is activated by dropping the user’s blood over the ring.

The name of this weave is from the [[Age of Legends]] and it was mentioned by [[Demandred]] while duelling with [[Gawyn]], who was using the ring.
